title: Choose the visual world for thunderforge.dev
question: The roll assigned The Character Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Character Sheet
options.lineage: the pencil-worn character sheet every player knows by heart (our own grammar, never a publisher's trade dress)
options.thesis: ThunderForge introduces itself the way every adventurer does: on a filled-in sheet.
materials: a live d20 in the margin
options.viewport: Name box reads THUNDERFORGE, class Virtual Tabletop, level 0 (unreleased); six ability boxes hold real measured numbers; a Roll button rolls the real Rust dice in the margin; Donate and Follow sit in the 'Allies & Organizations' box.
options.risk: Cream paper is the category's softest default; it must be worked in pencil, ink and slate so it reads as a played sheet, not parchment.

raised.raise: Every number on the sheet is ruled with its measurement and source, like a smith's chalk marks: no unmeasured stat.
The visitor's chosen table (in person / online / both) traces solid; the others stay dashed.
Each sheet section commits fully to one ink; no section is half-decorated.

options.label: The Battle Mat
options.lineage: wet-erase one-inch grid vinyl, four-color markers, painted minis
options.thesis: The homepage is the table: a vinyl grid where the story is drawn in marker as you scroll.
materials: hero tokens from the heroes package
options.viewport: Full-bleed grid mat; marker-drawn walls form the headline room; procedural hero tokens stand on squares; the real dice roll on the mat.
options.risk: The most obvious VTT metaphor; it is where most runs for this category would land.

options.label: Power-Hammer Forge
options.lineage: a blacksmith's forge under the power hammer
options.thesis: The project forged blow by blow, heat by heat.
options.viewport: A white-hot billet stretched by each scroll blow.
options.case: Fuses on the name only: players identify with the table, not the smithy.
options.kept: Every number ruled with its measurement.
options.risk: Literal reading of the name; says nothing about play.

options.label: Sewing Pattern Envelope
options.lineage: home sewing pattern envelopes and tissue
options.thesis: Views A, B, C of one tabletop.
options.viewport: Envelope front with three views of a table.
options.case: Fuses poorly: tabletop players do not read the sewing room.
options.kept: The chosen variant traces solid, the rest dashed.

options.label: Saul Bass Title Sequence
options.thesis: The creator's story told as a ninety-second title sequence.
options.viewport: Burnt-orange field, a cut-paper hand rolling a die.
options.case: Strong story, weak proof: hides the product behind cinema.
options.kept: One committed field color per act.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.thesis: The server's event stream as a phosphor trace.
options.viewport: A trace of live world events.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark fantasy game-site hero: map art, glowing CTA, feature grid, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Brand mark and headline over a dark map, Try the demo + Donate buttons.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other VTT site by design.
